notes: Calmer, clearer runs: one special event at a time, rarer super modes, banners only for big moments, at most three screen-edge markers in one style, weak cards cut, Heart Containers capped at 10, two standing-still threats instead of four, no colour fringing. Polish: hit-stop on boss hits, dash squash and stretch, walking enemies step, a soft vignette, one warning style for everything about to land. New: a final boss and victory screen (then endless if you want), and five characters to unlock.
